goal: Design, on paper, a stationary tabletop low-voltage machine that presents miscellaneous small items to a camera, distinguishes visible categories, and diverts them into two bins. Investigate whether parts from four unrelated *faulty/unowned* devices could support it. Describe a functional architecture, alternate topology, electrical and mechanical interfaces, uncertainties, and an actual measurement plan. No device may be powered or claimed reusable.
